home.title: Plivvi — Free PDF Tools, Scanner & Digital Notebooks
home.description: Read, annotate, scan, merge, split and convert PDFs on your device. Free, open-source document tools and digital notebooks, with no required account.

tools.title: Free PDF Tools Online — Private & Open Source · Plivvi
tools.description: Choose from 35 free document tools: PDF editing, scanning, merging, splitting, conversion and OCR. Files are processed in your browser. No feature paywalls.

notebooks.title: Free Digital Notebook & Apple Pencil Writing · Plivvi
notebooks.description: Make ruled, dotted, grid, Cornell or blank notebooks. Write with Apple Pencil or a compatible pen, add text and photos, and export PDF or images for free.

templates.title: Free Document Templates & Copy Layouts · Plivvi
templates.description: Start with blank, lined, graph, invoice, letter and checklist pages. Arrange genuine ID and passport scans, then edit your document in the free reader.

guides.title: PDF & Scanning Guides — Practical Free Workflows · Plivvi
guides.description: Practical guides to private PDF workflows, iPhone document scanning, Apple Pencil notes, and Persian or Arabic OCR. Clear steps, useful tools and honest limits.

about.title: About Plivvi — Free, Open Source & Vibe Coded
about.description: Meet Plivvi, a free document workshop made by Ramtin Neshatvar. Explore its open-source code, privacy approach and community contributions.

privacy.title: Privacy & Local Document Processing · Plivvi
privacy.description: Learn how Plivvi processes documents on your device, saves browser drafts, and handles optional sign-in, cloud transfers and private bug reports.

contact.title: Contact Plivvi — Feedback, Bugs & Sponsorship
contact.description: Contact the Plivvi team for feedback, private bug reports, sponsorship and custom document workflows. Made by Ramtin Neshatvar.

support.title: Support Plivvi — Improve Free Open-Source Tools
support.description: Help improve Plivvi, fix bugs and keep every document feature free. Optional direct crypto donations, sponsorship and open-source contributions.
